title: Carter praying with his head on the table after the briefing
summary: Eric Davis tells of Carter praying with his head on the table after the briefing, about 1977 at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Alonzo told us that Jimmy or Cart President Carter has a habit of putting his head down on his table like this and praying.

plain: A physicist who has worked on Pentagon research, Eric Davis, passes on what a man named Alonzo McDonald told him and a lawyer, Dan Sheehan. According to Davis, McDonald said that President Jimmy Carter, after being briefed on UFOs in 1977 at the White House, put his head down on the table, as was his habit, and prayed. It is told as a sign of how heavy the news in that briefing was said to be.
